title: 第7章 定居朝暮第8章 学院的决定
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
九州大陆之北，世称北境，亦或者北部，北境之大足足有数十州，横跨万里，种族无数，各教各派并存，其中便有最近闹得人心惶惶的青圣教，但这之前北境要数宣州为最，为何？因为宣州有一座北安城！
何谓北安城？顾名思义，不难理解，北安城中有一处圣地，名为北宣学院，这是北境十王当年以族人之血，以自身性命打拼出来的荣耀。
待到天道宫夫子一统九州后，念及北境十王之功，故设宣州北安城为北境中心，十王之首的明王建立北宣学院，从此便成了圣地，可这已经是很久很久以前的事情了...
虽然如今已不复昔日荣耀，但世人口口相传，北安城也好，北宣学院也罢，毕竟得到了世人的认可.
这一日一位白裙少女来到了这里，看着眼前充满历史气息的北安城，慕容仙暗道这才像个样子，终于有座能入眼的古城了，而此人正是坠入空间裂缝的慕容仙，被左丘辰等人所救后，在第二天醒来后独身离开。
虽有伤在身，慕容仙最开始还挺谨慎，直到醒来后发现这片大陆稀薄的灵气，天道似乎有缺，后又查探到左丘族那些人境界后，她知道她这是虎落平阳了啊。
少女无奈同时伸出手掌，看了看掌心中的黑点暗暗叹气。“噬灵阵都用上了，好大的手笔，等姑奶奶恢复了，定杀上你们族中屠尽所有！”
“但话说回来，就这片大陆，还得找人解除我身上的噬灵阵才行！”
少女无奈，本是天骄之人，碍于家族，已经隐藏境界，低调行事，奈何事与愿违，偏偏受伏后又落到这九州大陆...
这一日，北宣学院七大长老之一的徐天正值他在学院的灵妙殿授课，突然发现一道陌生的灵力之气闯入。
“谁？”
一声大喝传出，徐老喝问道，吓得殿中学生一个颤栗。
“这学院管事的何在？”同时一声娇斥也是传来。
作为北宣学院的长老，徐老当仁不让瞬间掠出，只见院内一位白衣女子破门而入，一跃数十米，随后只见其身影已然站立在学院广场之中。
“哪来的贼子，敢擅闯北宣学院？”徐老飞身出击，一掌飞去，可是下一刻，只见白衣女子单手一掌迎来。
“轰~”的一声，灵力震碎，两掌相碰，首先被震退的居然是徐老。
“你是谁？”
徐老自三百年前成为北宣学院的长老，一身修为早已经步入三生境，但是此刻居然被眼前这个年轻女子震退，这让他暗暗心惊。
仔细打量这个女子，虽然一副少女模样，但是徐老心知，修道中人，特别是女性，爱慕容颜者，大多以许多秘法保持青春永驻，所以此刻徐老打算先问清此女来路，再一个他心中也没底，一掌就拍退自己，根本不是一个档次的啊...
而学院四周早已经人山人海，汇聚了密密麻麻的学院弟子，皆是震惊的看着场中神秘的白衣女子。

“好厉害，一掌居然震退了徐长老。”
“是啊，徐长老可是渡过三生境的强者，听说即将进入三死境。”
所有学院弟子都在议论，这让徐长老老脸一红，自己修道这数百年，何曾这样丢过脸？
“嘻嘻，老头，你才到三生境，我怕失手打死你，快叫你们的老大出来。”
白衣少女俏皮一笑，然后丝毫不惧徐老，少女还不时转目打量着四周，看着这北宣学院的弟子，眼中尽是好奇。
“这些地方的修炼者果然都是从最底层开始，原来书上没有骗我。”慕容仙心中暗道，同时嘴角微翘，至少满足了自己的好奇心。
“你...老夫就看看你有多大本事，天狼诀！”
徐老被气得七窍冒烟，再加上慕容仙那不屑和不在意的神情，这让徐长老瞬间就要暴走，但就在这时。
“徐老，住手！”
一道浑厚的声音传出，接着一位白发黑衣的老者出现，只见此人一手搭在徐老左臂，顿时徐老所有气势化为乌有。
“不错，三生握天地，灵力驾驭也还算凑合。”
不待白发老者说话，慕容仙直接出口点评，根本没把这位强者放在眼里。
“严副院长。”
“见过副院长~~”
四周所有学院弟子作揖，就连徐老也是收手弯腰行礼。
被称为严副院长的老者抬手示意众人，然后双目打量着前方这个白裙女子。
的确进入了三死境的确实不一样，再加上三死境强者至少也有千岁寿命，不论是实战还是人生阅历都超过在场所有人。
看着眼前女子，直觉告诉严副院长此女不是一般人，故此也是放下姿态道。
content_en:
The northern part of the Kyushu Continent is known as the Northern Territory, or the North. The Northern Territory is so large that there are dozens of states, spanning thousands of miles, with countless races, and various sects and sects coexisting. Among them is the Qingsheng Sect, which has caused panic recently. But before this, Xuanzhou was the largest in the Northern Territory. Why? Because there is a Bei'an City in Xuanzhou!
What is Bei'an City? As the name suggests, it is not difficult to understand that there is a holy place in Bei'an City called Bei Xuan Academy. This is the glory that the ten kings of the North fought for with their own lives and blood.
After the Master of Tiandao Palace unified the Nine Provinces, he thought of the achievements of the ten kings in the north, so he established Bei'an City in Xuanzhou as the center of the north. King Ming, the leader of the ten kings, established Beixuan Academy, which has become a holy place since then, but this was a long, long time ago...
Although it has lost its former glory, word of mouth has spread throughout the world, and Bei'an City and Bei Propaganda College have finally been recognized by the world.
On this day, a girl in a white dress came here. Looking at the historical Bei'an City in front of her, Murong Xian secretly thought that this is what it looks like. Finally, there is an ancient city that can be seen. This person was Murong Xian who fell into the space crack. After being rescued by Zuo Qiuchen and others, he woke up the next day and left alone.
Although she was injured, Murong Xian was quite cautious at first, until she woke up and found that the thin spiritual energy in this continent, and the way of heaven seemed to be lacking. Later, when she found out the realm of those people from the Zuoqiu tribe, she knew that she was in trouble.
The girl helplessly stretched out her palms at the same time, looked at the black spots in her palms, and sighed secretly. "The spirit-eating array has been used. It's such a big deal. When my aunt recovers, I will kill everyone in your clan!"
"But having said that, in this continent, I still need to find someone to remove the spirit-eating array from my body!"
The girl was helpless. She was a talented person, but because of her family, she had hidden her realm and acted in a low profile. However, everything went against her wishes. After being ambushed, she ended up in the Kyushu Continent...
On this day, Xu Tian, one of the seven elders of Beixuan College, was teaching in the Lingmiao Hall of the college when he suddenly noticed a strange spiritual energy coming in.
"Who?"
A loud shout was heard, and Mr. Xu asked, frightening the students in the palace to tremble.
"Who is in charge of this college?" At the same time, a scolding voice came.
As the elder of Beixuan College, Xu Lao did his duty and rushed out instantly. He saw a woman in white breaking through the door and jumping tens of meters. Then she saw her figure already standing in the college square.
"What kind of thief dares to break into Beixuan College without permission?" Xu Laofei attacked and flew away with a palm, but the next moment, he saw the woman in white greeting him with a palm of one hand.
With a sound of "Boom~", the spiritual power was shattered, and the two palms collided. The first person to be knocked back was Mr. Xu.
"Who are you?"
Mr. Xu had become an elder of Beixuan College three hundred years ago, and his cultivation had already entered the realm of three lives. However, at this moment, he was actually repulsed by the young woman in front of him, which made him secretly shocked.
Looking carefully at this woman, although she looks like a girl, Mr. Xu knows in his heart that people in the cult, especially women, who love beauty, mostly use many secret methods to maintain their youth forever, so at this moment, Mr. Xu intends to ask about the origin of this woman first, and then he has no idea, and slaps him away with one palm, which is not the same level at all...
There was already a sea of people around the academy, densely packed with academy disciples, all looking at the mysterious woman in white in shock.
"It's so powerful. I actually knocked back Elder Xu with one palm."
"Yes, Elder Xu is a strong man who has passed through the three realms of life. I heard that he is about to enter the three realms of death."
All the disciples in the academy were discussing, which made Elder Xu blush. In the hundreds of years he has been practicing Taoism, has he ever been so embarrassed?
"Hehe, old man, you have just arrived at the Three Lives Realm. I am afraid that I will accidentally kill you, so please call your boss out."
The girl in white smiled playfully, and then she was not afraid of Mr. Xu at all. From time to time, the girl turned her eyes and looked around, looking at the disciple of Beixuan College, her eyes filled with laughter.Just curious.
"As expected, the practitioners in these places all start from the bottom. It turns out that the book didn't lie to me." Murong Xian thought to himself, while the corners of his mouth slightly raised, which at least satisfied his curiosity.
"You... let me see how capable you are, the Heavenly Wolf Technique!"
Elder Xu was so angry that his mouth was filled with smoke. Coupled with Murong Xian's disdainful and indifferent expression, Elder Xu was about to run away in an instant, but at this moment.
"Mr. Xu, stop!"
A deep voice came out, and then an old man with white hair and black clothes appeared. This man put his hand on Mr. Xu's left arm, and all the momentum of Mr. Xu suddenly disappeared.
"Yes, he can control the world in three lives, and his control of spiritual power is pretty good."
Without waiting for the white-haired old man to speak, Murong Xian commented directly, not taking this strong man seriously at all.
"Vice President Yan."
“I’ve met the vice president~~”
All the disciples from the surrounding academy bowed, and even Mr. Xu stopped his hands and bowed down to salute.
The old man known as Vice President Yan raised his hand to signal to everyone, and then looked at the woman in the white dress in front of him.
It is true that those who have entered the Three Death Realm are different. In addition, the strong people in the Three Death Realm have at least a thousand years of life, and their actual combat and life experience exceeds that of everyone present.
Looking at the woman in front of him, Vice President Yan intuitively told him that this woman was not an ordinary person, so he lowered his attitude and said.
